create_sampled_multi_epoch_dataset: create a SampledMultiEpochDataset instance with multiple sub-datasets and sampling ratios for multilingual training
build_virtual_epoch_dataset: build a dataset that samples from multiple sub-datasets using virtual epoch sizes to speed up dataloading
test_set_epoch: test the set_epoch method to advance to the next virtual epoch and regenerate global indices
review_sizes_property: review the sizes property that returns epoch-specific sample sizes indexed by random global indices
refactor_next_global_indices: refactor the _next_global_indices method to customize how random global indices are generated per epoch
